title: 焚化爐爐排燃燒控制
summary: 本課以「以熱量、料床停留與排放證據理解爐排燃燒控制」為主軸，依序處理垃圾熱值與負荷邊界、爐排速度與物料停留、煙氣污染質量通量、整合煙氣處理績效、毛發電與淨效益。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Understand grate combustion through heat input, bed residence and emission evidence, progressing through Waste heating value and load boundary, Grate motion and material residence, Flue-gas pollutant mass rate, Integrated flue-gas treatment performance, Gross generation and net benefit. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 垃圾熱值與負荷邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Waste heating value and load boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 垃圾熱值與負荷邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Waste heating value and load boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將濕基進料、含水率及熱值連結，從源頭解釋蒸汽與煙氣波動。 燃料熱輸入由濕基進料量與對應低位熱值決定；相同噸數可能帶入不同熱量。
steps.instructionEn: Link wet feed, moisture and heating value to explain steam and flue-gas fluctuations at the source. Fuel heat input is wet feed multiplied by its corresponding lower heating value; equal tonnage can carry different heat input.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕基進料 m=2000 kg/h；假設低位熱值 LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 P=m*LHV/3600，計算得 4.44444 MW。適用邊界：平均熱值與穩態完全燃燒上限；不包含未燃損失及輔助燃料。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet-feed rate m=2000 kg/h; assumed lower heating value LHV=8 MJ/kg. Formula P=m*LHV/3600 gives 4.44444 MW. Applicability: Mean heating value and a steady complete-combustion input estimate; unburned losses and auxiliary fuel are excluded.
steps.failure: 只控制質量流率而忽略含水與熱值，會造成熱負荷波動。 在「垃圾熱值與負荷邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Mass-flow control alone misses heat-load changes caused by moisture and heating value. Mark where this error can enter the Waste heating value and load boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「垃圾熱值與負荷邊界」，依代表性分樣求含水與熱值，和料重、蒸汽負荷及未燃分交叉檢查。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Waste heating value and load boundary, Use representative samples for moisture and heating value, cross-checking feed mass, steam load and unburned residue. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「焚化爐爐排燃燒控制」的「垃圾熱值與負荷邊界：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「資源循環物料站」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Waste heating value and load boundary: Mechanism and observation” in “Grate-combustion control in waste incinerators”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Circular-resource material station” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 一次與二次空氣的功能：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Primary and secondary air roles: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 一次與二次空氣的功能 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Primary and secondary air roles and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 一次空氣穿過料床，二次空氣協助氣相混合；總量與分配必須分開評估。 實際空氣量為理論空氣量乘過量係數；更多空氣也增加煙氣及熱損失。
steps.instructionEn: Primary air passes through the bed while secondary air supports gas mixing; assess totals separately from distribution. Actual air is stoichiometric air times the excess-air ratio; more air also increases flue-gas flow and heat loss.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：理論需氧量 O=800 kg/h；空氣氧分率 x=0.232；假設過量空氣比 λ=1.4。公式 air=lambda*O/x，計算得 4827.59 kg/h。適用邊界：元素氧需求已知且混合理想的紙上比較；不是燃燒控制設定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Stoichiometric oxygen O=800 kg/h; air oxygen mass fraction x=0.232; assumed excess-air ratio λ=1.4. Formula air=lambda*O/x gives 4827.59 kg/h. Applicability: Known elemental oxygen demand and ideal mixing for a paper comparison, not a combustion-control setting.
steps.failure: 總氧量足夠但配風不均，仍可能產生局部未燃區。 在「一次與二次空氣的功能」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Sufficient total oxygen with poor distribution can still leave locally unburned zones. Mark where this error can enter the Primary and secondary air roles flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「一次與二次空氣的功能」，同時比對氧氣、一氧化碳與溫度；分辨整體缺氧和局部混合不足。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Primary and secondary air roles, Compare oxygen, carbon monoxide and temperature together to separate global oxygen shortage from local poor mixing. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
